population: B2B clean-train folds 0-3 only (1421 queries); fold4=611 and B2B 581 sealed
question_and_packets: original source text available at deployment; no answer labels or Target outputs used for ordering
scoring: per-query BM25 on 12 source packet texts; lowercase ASCII alphanumeric tokens; k1=1.2, b=0.75; IDF log(1+(N-df+0.5)/(df+0.5)); no stemming, stopword tuning, title boost, or feedback
ties: V8 packet order, then packet id
decoder: single add-only 12-packet trajectory; frozen exact lattice used only for read-only evaluation
comparators: lineage-clean V8 fallback on the same query
fixed V13 rank-1 trajectory on the same query
metrics: cumulative five-anchor oracle cost among paired Complete
decision: If lexical ordering does not improve both reachability and penalized token cost against at least V8 on train-only, close this simple text-ranking branch; no validation role may be used to tune tokenization or weights
